limitations: Automated URL checks validate syntax, not live availability of every external page.

Descriptions derived from official pages are intentionally brief and should not replace the original published source text.
Related sources are opt-in, are not necessarily EMA-controlled holdings, and should be checked against the original source and any later relevant publications before operational reliance.
